data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding (claims reserves) at 1 January 2015 was identified from the balance sheet as approximately GBP 48.51m. The report images provided did not contain an unambiguous, extractable GROSS figure for the prior-year reserve movement (movement in prior years' provision for claims outstanding) in the notes accessible from the supplied images. As a result the prior-year development amount and per-LOB reserve movements could not be determined from the available pages.
data.data_quality_notes: Extraction limited by image-quality / rotation and partial legibility. Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Balance Sheet / Technical provisions liabilities table (2014 comparative column) found on page labelled '26' in the supplied images (value read as 48,510 = GBP 48.51k thousands = GBP 48.51m). Gross written premium taken from the Key Performance Indicators table (page ~5) showing 83,398 = GBP 83.398m. No unambiguous GROSS 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' line (insurance liabilities column) was confidently readable in the provided images; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is left null rather than using P&L 'claims incurred in relation to prior underwriting years' lines or a NET figure. No clear gross claims development triangle was readable. Recommend providing higher-resolution images or the original PDF text-extract for precise extraction of prior-year development, per-LOB movements, and claims development triangle.
